# Product strategy

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

Deciding which problem a product solves, for which users, and what it leaves out. Strategy sets the goals that the other disciplines work toward.

## References

- You study customer needs or test a product idea. Read [Product discovery](product-discovery.md).
- You set a goal, a metric, or a target for a product or a feature. Read [Product measurement](product-measurement.md).
- You define the market, the competitors, or the target customers of a product. Read [Product positioning](product-positioning.md).
- You set the order of the items in a backlog or a roadmap. Read [Prioritization](product-prioritization.md).
- You write or review the strategy of a product, a team, or a company. Read [Strategy formulation](strategy-formulation.md).
